primaryInterface: A self-closing named ref reuses the same footnote within its exact group; a repeated use inserts an additional marker.
classification: Declared redundant-marker cleanup. Marker count and backlinks change, so original rendered HTML is not claimed equivalent.
boundaries: Only complete literal top-level ref nodes with name/group attributes
Exactly one globally unique nonconflicting nonempty raw definition body for the same name/group
Only a self-call immediately following the same identity, with whitespace allowed
No intervening prose, opaque or unknown owner, bank inheritance, follow, details or extra attributes
The complete independently modeled expected reference graph and all rendered lists must match the actual endpoint
Distinct body, group, name, unproved scope and unrelated-marker deletion mutations remain failures
